issue.title: Agents tab freshness on large-archive hosts
issue.description: The Agents tab reflects load/capacity, unread notification, and node status changes within seconds on hosts with tens of thousands of stored agents, without adding per-tick TUI cost.

issue.title: Stop refresh-pulse writes from poisoning the bounded artifact-delta path
issue.description: pulse-delta: classify project-level .ace_refresh_pulse watcher paths as a pure freshness kick instead of an unknown_watcher_path fallback (leaving per-agent-directory pulses exact for sase-zr.7.3), and fix sase-zc by routing the two misplaced pulse writers through the existing touch_shell_refresh_pulse helper.

issue.title: Give the load/capacity indicator a cheap refresh path independent of broad loads
issue.description: capacity-fresh: recompute the runner-capacity snapshot from the in-memory roster on tab entry with a guard so older in-flight loads cannot overwrite it, token-track limit-override/holds changes, and fix the stale agent-info metrics memo key.

issue.title: Take the federation attention RPC off the auto-refresh critical path
issue.description: tick-diet: make per-tick fleet-attention polling cache-backed with a longer network recompute cadence, run it concurrently with local surfaces, and add tick trace counters for it.

issue.title: Cut broad Tier 1 load and post-apply warmup cost on large archives
issue.description: broad-load-diet: profile then cache/coalesce the unwindowed per-load project/patch sweeps, the bead-confirmation/monitor/live-hint warmups, the detail-header rebuilds, and evaluate incremental Tier 1 index revalidation.

issue.title: Remove Agents-tab UI-thread hitches (unread ack, info-panel countdown)
issue.description: ui-hitches: move the unread-ack notification-store mutation off the UI thread with optimistic row updates, and make the 1 s info-panel countdown patch only the countdown segment.

issue.title: Bounded marker polling so in-flight node status converges without broad loads
issue.description: inflight-status: extend the STARTING-row 1 s stat poll to all in-flight rows so marker transitions schedule exact artifact-delta refreshes within seconds even when inotify misses events.

issue.title: Before/after verification on athena and regression coverage
issue.description: verify: capture before/after trace, perf, and stall data on athena against the acceptance targets, run the benches, and record results on the epic bead.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: the Agents load lane still misses this epic's 'unread ... within seconds' goal on athena. Evidence from ~/.sase/logs on 2026-09-24 (tui_toasts.jsonl lined up against tui_agent_load_slow in tui_agent_loads.jsonl): after completion toasts at 18:00:24, 18:00:35 and 18:02:49, the notification-sourced exact delta finished 8.0 s, 14.8 s and 20.7 s later. Each one waited behind an in-flight inflight_poll delta (up to 15 s: disk 9.3 s, prep 5.5 s) and then paid its own disk (2.3-8.1 s) and prep (1.0-4.6 s). Slow loads alone (2 s or more) kept the single _agents_loading lane busy 23-31% of every hour. By total slow-lane time, inflight_poll (sase-124.6) is the largest source at 1613 s today, ahead of auto_refresh at 1549 s. Among the slow loads, notification deltas had disk p50 3.3 s and p90 9.1 s, and inflight_poll deltas had disk p50 2.9 s, max 69.6 s. A one-dir load_agent_artifact_delta_from_disk_with_state takes about 0.3 s in an idle process. _drain_pending_agents_refresh_work also starts a pending broad refresh before a pending delta. Host load average is 22-37 on 64 cores even though sase-14x's duplicate daemons are gone (1 service, 1 scheduler). Tale plan completion_unread_same_tick works around this for completion unread markers with an off-loop exact status probe and a short-lived overlay; the lane's cost and ordering remain this epic's to fix.
